story: A sender box fires a webhook envelope -> the receiver robot catches it and its screen shows the request as glowing lines -> it throws a replay back to the sender, which lights up -> loop.
caption: Catch → inspect → replay

keyframe-reference.png.use: image reference for the packet in flight

picked.model: seedance_2_5 (Seedance 2.5), mode omni_reference, 7 s, 720p, no audio
picked.why: Clear catch, a readable screen readout while holding the packet, a clean throw back, the sender flashes on receipt. No warps.

rejected.why: Packet is small and the screen readout is brief.
Good, but the sender's port pops off as a loose disc for a few frames.

web.edit: full clip, 0.6 s dissolve from the end into the start for a seamless loop

files.explainer.mp4: H.264 high, 960x540, 24 fps, 6.4 s, CRF 27, faststart, no audio, 166 KB
files.explainer-poster.webp: robot holding the packet, screen readout on, 17 KB

takes: takes/*_sheet.jpg are contact sheets (one frame every 0.5 s) of every take, kept for review
